mains.headline: Trump lands in Manila for Quad summit
mains.summary: The US president arrives for the Quad leaders' meeting, then flies to Shenzhen for APEC.

mains.headline: Ukraine drops a Kerch Bridge span
mains.summary: Kyiv says its forces dropped a span of the bridge to Crimea, as Russia hits Kyiv bridges.

mains.headline: Nvidia revenue doubles to $115.8bn
mains.summary: Data-centre sales hit $107.6bn in the first results since Huang resigned; return barred.

mains.headline: Iran drones hit US radar in Bahrain
mains.summary: Iran's drones hit a US radar site in Bahrain; US jets hit Qeshm in reply.

mains.headline: Cyclone Akvan nears India at 145 km/h
mains.summary: Forecast to hit the Andhra coast on Friday; Odisha plans mass evacuations.

mains.headline: Knesset elects Kahana as speaker
mains.summary: Lawmakers pick the Eisenkot ally 66–52, replacing Likud's Ohana as speaker.

mains.headline: EU proposes €45bn loan for Ukraine
mains.summary: Brussels offers two-thirds of Kyiv's €70bn gap, repaid from Russian assets.

mains.headline: Britain sanctions settlement builders
mains.summary: London freezes assets of eight Israeli firms and the Tzav 9 group.

mains.headline: China cuts tariffs for Canada
mains.summary: Xi meets PM Carney as Beijing cuts tariffs and pledges C$400M in aid.

mains.headline: Dow plunges 849 points
mains.summary: The Dow sheds 848.75 points; the S&P 500 hits its lowest close since July.

mains.headline: APEC opens in Shenzhen
mains.summary: Leaders gather in Shenzhen; the Trump–Xi–Putin trilateral is Thursday.
